_comment: Defaults for kitchens-joinery. The client's own config.json overrides anything here — objects merge, arrays replace whole. Edit freely; nothing regenerates this.
responsePromise: We come back to every enquiry within a day.

process.detail: How you actually use the space decides the layout more than the finishes do.
Drawings and a quote with the hardware and materials named, so you know what you are getting.
Built in the workshop to your measurements, not adjusted on site.
In and finished with the least disruption we can manage.

faq.q: How long will my kitchen be out of action?
faq.a: Usually days rather than weeks, because the cabinetry is made before we start pulling anything out.

faq.q: Do you handle plumbing and electrical?
faq.a: We coordinate the trades so you are not managing three diaries.
Both have their place. We will tell you where the money actually shows and where it does not.
Usually. Bring us a photo or a door and we will tell you honestly how close we can get.
